predicted_reason: This product is classified as Other igneous rock, specifically an off-white stone with gray streaks and black flecks, comprised predominantly of quartz and plagioclase feldspars. It is polished on top and has simply cut or sawn sides, falling under the heading of other natural stones, e.g., marble, granite, etc., whether or not worked but not shaped into building stone.
